audit_items.proof_trace: Production builds lack synchronization on params.BeaconConfig() access. Concurrent OverrideBeaconConfig() during UpgradeToFulu creates a race where fork.current_version can diverge from the configuration value read at construction time. No post-upgrade validation enforces the invariant.
audit_items.attack_scenario: Attacker triggers config reload (via admin API or file watcher) during fork upgrade window. Race between OverrideBeaconConfig writing configs.active and UpgradeToFulu reading FuluForkVersion causes state to have inconsistent fork version, leading to consensus split.
